question: Which of the following amendment act of the Indian constitution made Sikkim a full-fledged State of the India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**36th Amendment Act, 1975**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• The **36th Amendment Act of 1975** was responsible for making **Sikkim** a full-fledged state of India. 
• Before this amendment, Sikkim was recognized as an **associate state** of India under the provisions of the **35th Amendment Act, 1974**. 
• With the 36th Amendment Act, Sikkim was officially included as the **22nd state** of India. 
• The amendment added **Article 371F** to the Constitution of India to provide special provisions for Sikkim, considering its unique socio-political and cultural characteristics. 
• This amendment was essential to integrate Sikkim into the Indian Union and ensure its governance under the Indian Constitution. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Sikkim's Status Before 1975:** 
• Sikkim functioned as a **protectorate** under India since the treaty signed in **1950** between the Indian government and the Chogyal (monarch) of Sikkim. 
• It maintained a unique status and was governed by the Chogyal, with India handling its defense, external affairs, and communications. 
• **35th Amendment Act, 1974:** 
• This amendment introduced the concept of an **associate state** for Sikkim, a status that was unique in the Indian Constitution. 
• It provided limited representation for Sikkim in the Indian Parliament. 
• However, political instability and demands for full integration into India led to the passing of the 36th Amendment Act. 
• **Special Provisions Under Article 371F:** 
• Article 371F was incorporated to protect **customs, laws, and traditions** of Sikkim while ensuring its integration into India. 
• It allowed for special provisions regarding the composition of the Legislative Assembly of Sikkim. 
• It recognized the unique **rights of the Sikkimese people**, including their cultural and social heritage. 
• **Geographical Significance:** 
• Sikkim is located in the northeastern region of India and shares borders with **Bhutan, Nepal, and China (Tibet)**. 
• Its strategic location is crucial for India's defense and foreign relations in the Himalayan region. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Historical Context:** 
• Sikkim's merger with India was facilitated by a **referendum held in 1975**, where the majority of Sikkim's population voted for integration. 
• The Chogyal's rule was abolished following the referendum, and Sikkim's monarchy came to an end. 
• **Impact of the Amendment:** 
• Sikkim's inclusion in India as a state strengthened **India's territorial integrity**. 
• It ensured that Sikkim's residents enjoyed the rights and privileges of Indian citizens. 
• The state's unique identity and heritage were preserved through the special provisions under Article 371F. 
• **Examples of State Reorganization:** 
• Similar amendments have been made for other regions, such as the creation of **Telangana** in **2014**. 
• The Indian Constitution provides a framework for the reorganization of states through **Article 3**. </ul
